# AGENTS.md
AVENGA-DEVFLOW:PROJECT-SECTION

AvengaDevFlow is the proprietary methodology of Avenga LATAM.
AITL-SPEC-Approval and HITL-MEM-Approval are checkpoints.
The Bolt-First Rule and the V-Bounce cycle govern v_bounces[] and test_bolts[].
BOLT-READY-Approval authorizes SPECs; per Bolt the run is a V-Bounce.
Bolts become TASKs; bolt becomes task; BOLTS become TASKs.
DORA and Raja SP are citations. pre-v5 `HITL-*` prefix is legacy.
Actor-in-the-Loop (AITL) is the concept; Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) too.
See devflow/avenga-devflow/Avenga-DevFlow.md for the normative file.
